name: Rhode Island State House
summary: The Rhode Island State House in real LEGO parts: white marble wings of three storeys, the pavilion's arched bronze doors and columns, the ribbed dome on its colonnaded drum among four cupolas, the gilded Independent Man, the terrace and the grand steps. Inside, the rotunda under its painted dome, the House and Senate chambers with their members, the State Room, and the two-storey State Library.

name: Beavertail Light
summary: Beavertail Light in real LEGO parts: the square granite tower with its iron gallery and glazed lantern, the keeper's house, the museum and the aquarium in white under red hip roofs, and the rocky shore below with the rail along the cliff. Inside, a spiral stair up the tower to the keeper at his log, the keeper's family at home, the old lens in the museum, and fish in the tanks.

name: The Towers
summary: The Narragansett Towers in real LEGO parts: two round granite towers under slate cones, the arch that carries Ocean Road between them, the great room's ribbon of windows under a dormered roof and an open belfry, and the stone wing beside them. Inside, a ballroom over the road with a grand piano and dancers, spiral stairs in the towers, a bar, and a kitchen in the wing.

name: The Towers (Façade)
summary: The Towers (Façade) in real LEGO parts: the street front of the Narragansett Towers on a shallow base, at the full model's scale with the rooms behind left out. Two round granite towers under slate cones; between them the arch that carries Ocean Road, a car in its passage and another coming out; over it the great room's ribbon of sage windows under a steep dormered roof, the open belfry with its gold bell, and the chimney; beside them the stone wing with its green door. In front, the road and its crossing, a granite wall with a hedge of hydrangeas, two lamp posts and a tree. The back is a plain granite wall, so it sits neatly on a shelf or against a wall.

name: Warwick Neck Light
summary: Warwick Neck Light in real LEGO parts: the white cast-iron tower on the bluff with its black gallery, its lantern and green light, the keeper's house of white clapboard under steep red roofs with its porch and brick chimney, the little garage, the flag and the Adirondack chairs on the lawn, and the stair down the bluff to the seawall and the keeper's skiff. Inside, a spiral stair up the tower to the keeper at the lens, the parlour and the kitchen, bedrooms under the roofs, and buoys being painted in the garage.

name: Carrie Tower
summary: Brown University's Carrie Tower in real LEGO parts, the centrepiece of its corner of the green: the red-brick campanile with five deep grooves up each face, on a pale limestone base with its benches, festoons and narrow door up three steps; the four verdigris clocks, stopped at twelve, under a bracketed cornice; the balustrade and its urns, and the open belvedere of clustered columns under a small green dome. Around it, lawn and paths, shade trees and a tree in blossom, the black iron fence between brick piers along Waterman and Prospect Streets, lamp posts, benches and a tour group. Inside, the vestibule with the memorial plaque, an iron spiral stair up the shaft, the clock room with the movement and its rods out to all four dials, and the old bells at the top.

name: Carrie Tower (Small)
summary: Brown University's Carrie Tower in real LEGO parts, the smaller of its two sizes: the red-brick campanile with five grooves up each face on its limestone base, with the inscriptions and the narrow door up three steps; four verdigris clocks stopped at twelve under a bracketed cornice; the balustrade and its urns, and the open belvedere of clustered columns under a small green dome. Around it a smaller corner of the green: lawn and a path, a shade tree and a tree in blossom, the black iron fence between brick piers along Waterman and Prospect Streets, a lamp post, benches and a tour group. Inside, the vestibule with the memorial plaque, an iron spiral stair up the shaft, the clock room with the movement and its rods to the four dials, and the bells.

name: The Stone and Cedar House
summary: The Stone and Cedar House in real LEGO parts: fieldstone and vertical cedar, the wing's roof climbing to a monitor of six windows beside the stone chimney, the two-storey centre proud under a shallow gable, the front door up steps under its own little gable, the garage bent back at an angle, rooms inside, and the drive looping round a planted island.

name: The Brick Colonial
summary: A brick colonial in real LEGO parts: warm taupe brick with cream sills, lintels and cornices under a grey hip roof; the entry stands forward under a pediment, its black door under a fanlight in a cream arch between two lanterns, the arched window over it; a bay under its own little roof, white double-hung windows in pairs, and the wing with its dormer and a two-car garage facing the drive at the side. A lawn mown in stripes, beds of boxwood, white hydrangeas and arborvitae along the house, a shade tree at the corner and tall trees behind, a lamp post at the walk, a patio at the back and two air-conditioning condensers by the house. Inside, the two-storey foyer and stair, the dining room with the children at their homework, the living room, the kitchen and the family room by the fire, three bedrooms and two baths upstairs, a bonus room over the garage, and the attic under the roof: insulation between the joists, the air handler and its ducts, and a technician at work on it.

name: The Brick Colonial (Façade)
summary: The Brick Colonial (Façade) in real LEGO parts: the front of the brick colonial on a shallow base, at the full model's scale with the rooms behind left out. Warm taupe brick with cream sills, lintels and cornice under a grey hip roof; the entry stands forward under its pediment, the black door with its wreath under a fanlight in a cream arch between two lanterns, the arched window over it; the bay under its own little roof, white double-hung windows in pairs, and the lower wing with its dormer. In front, a lawn mown in stripes, the walk with its lamp post and mailbox, beds of boxwood, hydrangeas and arborvitae, two small round trees and a shade tree at the corner. The back is a plain wall, so it sits neatly on a shelf or against a wall.

name: The Old Workings
summary: A mine nobody has worked in a long time: a propped adit into the hillside and an open cut beside it, ore still showing in both walls, the tramway out of the mouth going to rust and then to nothing, a cart on its side in the dirt, the headframe over the shaft with a brace missing, and weeds through the sleepers.

name: Corner Cottage
summary: A stone gate lodge in autumn, in real LEGO parts: a tower under a slate pyramid, a steep slate roof with a dormer and a green-gabled bay, the porch with its lantern, a glass conservatory, the tall chimney, a gravel drive, the gatepost and golden trees. Inside, the parlour by the fire, a kitchen with its range, a spiral stair up the tower, and bedrooms under the roof.

name: The Red Barn
summary: A red gambrel barn in real LEGO parts: barn-red board siding under a white curved roof, steep below and gentler above, with the cupola on the ridge, the hay hood over the white-framed hayloft door, and the wide doorway between small white windows. The workshop wing behind the board fence, the hen house and its picket run, the sliding door on its track at the back, the water trough, the meadow of wild flowers and the shade trees. Inside, horse and cow stalls along the aisle, the tack corner and the feed room, a ladder up to the hayloft with its stacked bales and a child jumping in the hay, the farmer at the workbench, and hens on their nests.

name: The Red Barn (Façade)
summary: The Red Barn (Façade) in real LEGO parts: the gable end of the red gambrel barn on a shallow base, at the full model's scale with the stalls and hayloft behind left out. Barn-red board siding with white corner boards on a concrete foundation, under the white roof, steep below and gentler above; the hay hood over the white-framed hayloft door, the cupola on the ridge, and the wide doorway between two barn lights and two white windows. The workshop wing on the left, the hen house under the eave on the right. In front, the board fence, a track through a meadow of wild flowers, milk cans, three hens and a shade tree. The back is a plain wall, so it sits neatly on a shelf or against a wall.

name: The Red Gables
summary: A two-storey family house with a three-car garage in real LEGO parts: dark grey lap siding with thin white trim, and three steep barn-red gables with black rakes, a big one on the left with a smaller one nested in front of it and one over the right-hand windows. A covered porch on slim white columns over stone bases, a black front door, white raised-panel garage doors with a row of dark panes, and three black lanterns. Burgundy shrubs, a blossoming tree and an evergreen frame the drive, and a concrete patio with a grill sits at the back. Inside, the foyer and stair, the living room, the dining table by the patio door, the kitchen with its island, the family nook, a half bath and the garage with its workbench; upstairs, the primary suite over the garage with its bath and walk-in closet, three more bedrooms, the hall bath and a reading landing.

name: The Stone Farmhouse
summary: A two-storey stone farmhouse in real LEGO parts: warm tan masonry with white quoins, sills and a stone arch, under low terracotta tile roofs with a tall chimney and black gutters. Dark brown shutters stand open at the upstairs windows, a vine in white flower climbs beside the arched glass doors, and lanterns light the lower wing that steps forward on the right. On the left a vine-covered pergola shades the supper table; in front, a gravel courtyard, a lawn with stepping stones, an olive tree, cypresses and a bed of lavender behind a low stone wall with its lamps. Inside, the kitchen with its range and island, the living room with a lit fireplace and the long table laid for supper, a wine store with barrels and a potting room; upstairs, the main bedroom, a bathroom and the children's room.

name: Rose Island Light
summary: Rose Island Light in real LEGO parts: the white clapboard keeper's house of 1870 under a grey slate mansard with two rust-red bands and arched white dormers, its brick chimney, and the square white tower rising from the roof to a black gallery and lantern, the lens inside under a domed cap. The house stands on the old fort's stone wall, railed in white, with the flag and deck chairs on top; below it the brick fog-signal house and its wooden steps, rock ledges, a strip of sand and the water of Narragansett Bay. Inside, as it was about 1912: the parlour with its player piano, the kitchen with the range and the cat, the pantry pump, bedrooms under the mansard, a ladder up the tower through the watch room to the lens, and the keeper's son at the engine in the fog-signal house.

name: Block Island Southeast Light
summary: Block Island Southeast Light in real LEGO parts: the Victorian light station on Mohegan Bluffs. The keeper's house of orange-red brick on a granite foundation, its very steep front gable edged in tan stone, white sash windows under curved stone hoods, tall corbelled chimneys, the kitchen wing, and a white entry porch hung with bunting; joined to it, the eight-sided brick tower with its black iron gallery, the lantern and its lens under a domed cap. A lawn with flowering shrubs, the path to the porch steps and the sea behind. Inside, an evening in the 1880s: the parlour with its fire and organ, the dining room laid for supper, the kitchen range, bedrooms and an attic under the steep roof, the keeper writing up the log, and a spiral stair up the tower to the watch room and the lens.

name: Conimicut Light
summary: Conimicut Light in real LEGO parts: the cast-iron “sparkplug” light of 1883 on its shoal off Warwick, where the Providence River meets Narragansett Bay. A reddish-brown caisson in a ring of granite riprap; on it a covered porch round the first storey, its roof edge grown over with grass; the white tower in banded tiers with small arched windows, the bracketed black gallery, the watch room, the lantern and its lens, and the tall antenna beside it. A grey iron stair runs down to the landing on its piles, in dark blue water with a grassy shore round the base. Inside, a winter evening about 1890: the cellar with its cistern and coal, the kitchen range, the living room by the stove, a spiral stair up to the bedroom, the assistant keeper's room, and the keeper at his log in the watch room.

name: Briarstone Hall
summary: Briarstone Hall in real LEGO parts: a Gothic Revival house of tan stone, its steep gables edged in grey under slate roofs with iron cresting along the top, white quoins and arched windows in pairs, a long arched verandah to the left, a carriage arch to the right, ivy on the corner and a pale boulder on the lawn. Behind it, a summer afternoon about 1890: tea on the terrace, a rose arbour, a lily pond with its footbridge, a tree swing, a game of croquet, the glasshouse and the vegetable beds. Inside, the verandah as a garden room among palms, the drawing room with its piano, the library, the dining room laid for dinner and the kitchen; upstairs the nursery and the schoolroom; and under the great gable, an artist's studio.

name: The Windmill at Hammersmith Farm
summary: The Windmill at Hammersmith Farm in real LEGO parts: a guest house in Newport, Rhode Island, built to look like a windmill without its sails. An eight-sided tower of grey shingle with a flared skirt at the second floor, a white balustraded balcony round the windowed room at the top, and a dark bell-shaped cap with its chimney; beside it a square three-storey block with a roof terrace, and a low wing. In front, a dry-stone wall with a bed of yellow flowers, a path across the lawn and big leafy trees. Inside, a summer afternoon: a sitting room with a boy and his toy boat, a bedroom with a girl reading by the window, a study with a telescope trained on the bay, people with binoculars in the room at the top and out on the balcony, deck chairs on the roof terrace, and the cook in the kitchen.

name: Cathedral of Saints Peter and Paul
summary: The Cathedral of Saints Peter and Paul in real LEGO parts: the brownstone cathedral in Providence, here in a warm reddish-brown with Tan string courses and trim under dark slate roofs. Two square towers stand either side of the front, crenellated, with gold clock dials on every face and tall louvred belfries; between them the rose window under its gable and gold cross, the triple doorway under its dark canopy, and wide steps with black rails down to the plaza. Down the side, buttressed walls with two tiers of windows and the transept with its own rose and cross; bare winter trees, flowering shrubs and an iron fence round it. Inside, a wedding: the bride on her father's arm halfway up the red carpet, the groom waiting at the sanctuary step, guests in the pews between green columns, the organ and choir in the gallery, Bishop Hendricken's tomb in the transept, and the bells and clock works up in the towers.

name: Cathedral of Saints Peter and Paul (Façade)
summary: The Cathedral of Saints Peter and Paul (Façade) in real LEGO parts: the west front of the Providence cathedral on a shallow base, at the full model's scale with the nave and transept behind left out. Two square crenellated towers at their full height, in warm reddish-brown with Tan string courses, gold clock dials and tall louvred belfries; between them the rose window in its Tan ring with a roundel either side, the row of five round-headed windows and the gable with its gold cross; at the foot the triple doorway under its dark canopy and the wide steps with black rails down to the plaza, with people on them, flowering shrubs and two bare winter trees. The back is a plain wall, so it sits neatly on a shelf or against a wall.

name: Historic St. Luke’s Church
summary: Historic St. Luke’s Church in real LEGO parts: the stone Episcopal church in East Greenwich, Rhode Island, in grey masonry with Tan dressings under steep slate roofs. At the corner the square tower rises to its louvred belfry and a tall slate spire with small gabled lights; beside it the round baptistery under its own low roof, and behind them the long nave, with a lower aisle under a lean-to roof and its buttresses down the side. A path turns the corner of the lawn between low stone walls, lamp posts and tall bare trees in early bud. Inside, a christening: the rector at the stone font with the baby, the parents and godparents, parishioners in the oak pews, choristers in the chancel, the brass eagle lectern, the altar with its candles, the organist at the organ and a ringer at the bell rope in the tower.

name: Trinity Church, Newport
summary: Trinity Church, Newport in real LEGO parts: the white wooden church of 1726, two tiers of tall round-headed windows down its long side under a grey roof, on a granite base. Its steeple rises in tiers: the clock tower with its black octagonal dial, a balustrade with slender pinnacles, the arched belfry and the lantern with their urns, and the slim white spire with gold balls and a gilded vane at the top. Round it, a brick-edged path, a hedge, the pine in its planter, old headstones and two tall bare trees. Inside, a Sunday service: white box pews, the three-decker wineglass pulpit in the middle aisle with the rector at the top, galleries on three sides with the organ and choir over the entrance, brass chandeliers, and the bell and clock works up in the tower.

name: The Lantern Church
summary: The Lantern Church in real LEGO parts: a modern church of warm tan stucco, its entrance a tall glass prow over a deep canopy on round columns, three faces of green glass braced in grey rising into a steep glazed gable crowned with a slim white cross. Two-storey wings either side under flat roofs with grey copings, an arched green window in each and glass storefronts below. Around it, a tan entrance court with grey walks, beds of red, yellow and white flowers, and leafy trees at both front corners. Inside, a Sunday morning: a greeter in the bright atrium under a lantern hung from the ridge; the sanctuary three steps up, with a tall white cross in the wall, the communion table, pulpit and font, a grand piano and rows of chairs under hanging lamps; the fellowship hall over coffee, and upstairs a Sunday-school class and the church office.
